# `aube store`

- **Usage:** `aube store <SUBCOMMAND>`
- **Effect:** read-only

Manage the global store

<!-- docs-navigation:start -->

## Examples

```sh
aube store path
aube store status
aube store prune --dry-run
```

Read the [workflow guide](/package-manager/node-modules) for context.
[Global options](/cli/#global-flags) apply to this command too.

<!-- docs-navigation:end -->
